title: Evolutionary Enlightenment
text: so evolutionary enlightenment is about the spiritual awakening devolution it's about the metaphysical recognition not just the intellectual scientific recognition but the metaphysical recognition such a part and parcel of a creative process that had a beginning 14 billion years ago and that creative process which is driven by an ecstatic urgency is going somewhere it's on a journey and who you are as a human being everything that you are biologically emotionally psychologically culturally and spiritually his part of that creative process and has been produced by that creative process in fact you are a human being that creative process becoming aware of itself through the body mind personality of yourself so you through this human incarnation through you through the highly developed complex cognition and complex awareness you're able to bear witness this entire unfolding its entire drama and in the context of enlightenment which is the metaphysical recognition and awakening to the fact that there's only one and not to that the ultimate nature of reality is that there's only one one being oneself one process one context one universe but ultimately that you are all of this and simultaneously you are the unique human being that you are right now within the complex context of self reflective awareness is able to bear witness to the entire drama you know in this extraordinary teaching we finally come to the realization that who I am and who you are is none other than the energy and intelligence that created the universe and is creating the universe right now bearing witness to itself through the extraordinary body mind personality that you are and in this process of bearing witness the entire creative display becomes self-aware become self conscious and in that in the in the awakening to that self consciousness the entire process lights up and self-knowledge and self knowing but that's a small little brief introduction to the teaching of evolutionary enlightenment
